plotEn:
During the time of the ancient Shu kingdom, seven symbols were inscripted on the eponymous Sanxingdui bronze statues using binary code.
In 2045, the same inscriptions were discovered by archaeologist Jiang Cheng.
In 2095, super-AI takes over society and is in charge with most decision-making causing a catastrophe. To stop an impending disaster, humanity works to decipher a warning left inside bronze artifacts.
